## How it was checked

- [ ] `npm test`, `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build` pass in `src/web`
- [ ] A test covers the changed behaviour – or the description says why none is needed

## Rules

The rules are in [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/leben-in-deutschland/leben-in-deutschland-app/blob/main/AGENTS.md); [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/leben-in-deutschland/leben-in-deutschland-app/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) has the short version.

- [ ] No secrets and no personal data: no keys, private e-mail addresses, home paths or device serials
- [ ] No data file edited by hand (question catalogue, evaluation status, exam centres)
- [ ] Release signing and store publishing are untouched – or the description says why
